title: Hello!
summary: Greet people morning and evening, answer the classic greetings and say goodbye.
intro: Today you meet the greetings you will hear every day, from Casablanca to Baghdad. You also start the alphabet with four letters: ا ب ت ث. Arabic is written from right to left, and most letters join the letter after them.
objectives: Greet people in the morning and in the evening
Answer a greeting with its fixed reply
Read and write the letters alif, baa, taa and thaa

realLife.title: Your first morning
realLife.story: Daniel, an American student, arrives at a language school in Cairo. Before he has even found his classroom, three people greet him: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر, مَرْحَبًا and السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ. By the end of today you can answer all three.

sentences.literal: the peace (be) upon you, O teacher
morning of the goodness, O Layla
evening of the goodness, O Sami

mistakes.why: marḥaban only means hello. To leave, say maʿa s-salāma.

dialogue.title: The first morning at school
dialogue.culture: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ is used by everyone, at any time of day. Men usually shake hands when they greet; wait for a woman to offer her hand first.

lines.ar: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر! أَنَا سَامِي. أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا فِي الْمَدْرَسَة!
lines.en: Good morning! I am Sami. Welcome to the school!

lines.ar: صَبَاحُ النُّور يَا سَامِي! أَنَا دَانْيَال. شُكْرًا!
lines.en: Good morning to you, Sami! I am Daniel. Thank you!

lines.ar: مَرْحَبًا يَا دَانْيَال! هٰذَا الْأُسْتَاذ كَرِيم.
lines.en: Hello, Daniel! This is the teacher, Mr Karim.

lines.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا دَانْيَال! أَهْلًا بِكَ.
lines.en: Peace be upon you, Daniel! You are welcome here.

lines.ar: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ يَا أُسْتَاذ! صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر.
lines.en: And upon you be peace, teacher! Good morning.

lines.ar: صَبَاحُ النُّور! الدَّرْس الْأَوَّل الْيَوْم: التَّحِيَّات.
lines.en: Good morning to you! The first lesson today is greetings.
Excellent! I really love the Arabic language.
Me too! Arabic is a very beautiful language.

lines.ar: مَسَاءُ الْخَيْر! الدَّرْس انْتَهَى. شُكْرًا يَا دَانْيَال.
lines.en: Good evening! The lesson is over. Thank you, Daniel.

lines.ar: مَسَاءُ النُّور يَا أُسْتَاذ! شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا.
lines.en: Good evening to you, teacher! Thank you very much.

lines.ar: مَعَ السَّلَامَة يَا دَانْيَال! إِلَى اللِّقَاء غَدًا.
lines.en: Goodbye, Daniel! Until we meet again tomorrow.

lines.ar: مَعَ السَّلَامَة يَا سَامِي! إِلَى اللِّقَاء!
lines.en: Goodbye, Sami! See you again soon!

reading.title: A note on the classroom door
reading.ar: أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا! صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر يَا طُلَّاب. الدَّرْس الْأَوَّل: التَّحِيَّات.
reading.en: Welcome! Good morning, students. The first lesson: greetings.

quiz.prompt: What is the reply to this greeting?
What is the reply to this greeting?
Which letter sounds like th in 'think'?
It is 7 p.m. Which greeting fits?

completion: Well done! You can greet people, answer greetings and say goodbye in Arabic, and you know your first four letters.
